Ram Temple donation theft investigation continues, draws political reactions

Investigations are underway into the alleged theft of donations at the Ram Temple in Ayodhya, with police questioning trust officials and employees. The Supreme Court has declined an urgent hearing on the matter, stating it is not an immediate crisis. Political figures have commented on the situation, with some calling for accountability and others cautioning against politicization.
